description: This script automates the process of creating a Git archive of the current project and comparing it with a specified distribution tarball to identify differences, particularly for autotools-related files.

methods.name: mktemp
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory for storing the archive.

methods.name: trap
methods.description: Sets up cleanup to remove the temporary directory upon script exit.

methods.name: rm
methods.description: Removes the temporary directory after use.

methods.name: git archive
methods.description: Creates a tar.gz archive of the current Git HEAD with a specific prefix.

methods.name: tardiff
methods.description: Compares the generated archive with an existing tarball to show differences.
